title.narrative: Supporting the Effective Reintegration of Returnees in the Western Balkans Phase II

description.narrative: The overall objective of this activity is to contribute to reducing the socio-economic gap between Roma and non-Roma populations and the discrimination of Roma women, men and children in the Western Balkans and Turkey; and contribute to support effective reintegration of vulnerable returnees from the EU with particular attention to Roma.
